desc: Styled after the original gallery guns of the late 1890s, the Rossi Gallery is a sliding-action pump rifle chambered for .22 LR. Available in either solid wood or durable black synthetic furniture, this rifle is an enjoyable tack-driver. Featuring a polished black 18-inch barrel and 15-round capacity tube magazine, the Gallery reintroduces one of the most endearing and fun target, plinking, and small-game hunting rifles in American history.
